about: Every release kept in this repository, as it shipped, and the one ./index.html is a copy of. Checked by scripts/check-releases.mjs (the 'releases' step of npm run verify). A release candidate is not listed until the owner promotes it.

Operation Final Coat, with the clAInk desktop fix and the week-13 cancel rule. Promoted on the owner's instruction; index.html until 2.1.1.
